manifest.purpose: Baseline diagnosis only; no policies changed; no exhaustive search or probabilistic win-rate estimate.
metricNotes: Robot-time categories are sampled every 0.05 simulated seconds.
Construction departures contain at least one place instruction; flip-only and Mustika trips are excluded from one/two-block counts.
Diagnostics may inspect actual future arrivals, but that information is never passed to a controller.
One-step-to-sanctuary refers only to observed tower shape and ownership, not cargo availability or a guaranteed completion time.
All scenarios are deterministic. Color-swapped scenarios change both the slow side and physical initial positions.
